title: Microsoft Teams: automatic recording and transcription options follow meeting policies
summary: Hold for licensing qualifications: the briefing leaves the Education A1 restriction on automatic recording unnecessarily open and omits Teams Premium from sensitivity-label enforcement. The rollout facts, automatic service-update default, and five published control paths and commands are supported.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AutoRecording Enabled | Disabled controls organizers' access to the automatic setting.
claims.quote:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AutoRecording Enabled
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AutoRecording Disabled

claims.claim: The AutoRecording policy applies to users and groups.
claims.quote: You can only apply this policy setting to users and groups.

claims.quote: There isn't an admin policy for Record and transcribe automatically. However, to control whether organizers have the Record and transcribe automatically setting in their Meeting options, you can use the Auto recording policy in PowerShell.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowCloudRecording $true | $false allows or blocks meeting recording.
claims.quote: To manage meeting recording by using PowerShell, use the -AllowCloudRecording parameter in Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy.
